purpose: Fixed-prior manifest: every non-learned prior with sha256 and provenance, referenced by hash from every rung receipt.
sha_convention: bytes on disk as-is (binary read, no line-ending normalization)
tree_digest_convention: combined_sha256 = sha256 over sorted '<name>\t<sha256>\t<size_bytes>\n' lines (scripts/manifest_sha.py convention); git-tracked files only
learned_import_attestation: Every item in this manifest is a NON-LEARNED prior. Zero imported learned weights, embeddings, learned-parameter tokenizers, teacher outputs, learned filters or judges, or hidden accelerator services (docs/authority/INVARIANT.md clause 3, fail-closed on unknown provenance).

energy_method.boundary_status: PERMANENT declared boundary by operator ruling; the upgrade to AC wall metering is UNPLANNED and no rung, claim, or publication conditions on it. A proxy point is never presented as a wall-metered point.
energy_method.cpu_package_energy_unit: picowatt-hours (Windows Energy Metering Interface); joules = raw * 3.6e-9

cpu_counter_chain_probed.detail: CLI present but produced no output within 20s (blocks without an elevated interactive console); unusable as a sampler

energy_method.sampling_cadence_note: Pinned cadence for the SAMPLED GPU leg. The CPU package leg reads a cumulative hardware counter as an endpoint difference, so it loses no energy to sampling gaps.
energy_method.idle_baseline_procedure: Both counters sampled for 10s with no Ember job resident, immediately before the measured interval. The baseline is REPORTED, never subtracted: the closed boundary charges whole-host draw, so subtracting idle would discount charged cost.
energy_method.integration: trapezoidal for the sampled leg; endpoint difference for the cumulative leg. Never a TDP multiplication.

host_governor.enforcement: In-run commit governor: at any phase boundary with free commit below the floor, the run checkpoints and cleanly aborts (R1 kill list). Commit starvation takes down the whole terminal, not merely the job.
host_governor.gpu_boundary: one RTX-4090-class 24 GiB GPU plus the declared local host
